0022600016.text: Boston, 3-1 and on a three-game winning streak, hosts Chicago (1-4, on a three-game losing streak) in its fifth game of the season. The Celtics are 2nd in the Atlantic, half a game back, and 4th in the East, while the Bulls are 4th in the Central, three games back, and 12th in the East. Boston is without Devin Carter (out, illness), and Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (out, hamstring) and Patrick Williams (out, groin soreness), with Tobe Awaka day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. The Celtics lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 134-99 win in Boston on October 26, and they won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
